list.title: Inbox
list.heading: Inbox ({count})
list.intro: Everything waiting for staff, oldest first: appeals, tickets, modmail, staff reports and automod review cards. Amber after a day, red after three.
list.failed: Could not be loaded right now: {kinds}. Those counts are not complete; reload to try again.

conversation.helpModmail: Sent as the bot, like typing in the Discord channel: the member gets a DM "Your server name (staff): …" and a copy is posted in the channel. Start with {prefix} for an internal note (posted in the channel only, never sent to the member).
conversation.helpTicket: Posted as the bot in the ticket channel (the member reads it there).
conversation.editingOff: Editing from the dashboard is off (DASHBOARD_EDIT_ENABLED): reply in Discord.
conversation.needsAdmin: Replying needs Administrator in the main server (bot owners without it can read only).
conversation.replyHint: Up to {max} characters; nobody is pinged.
conversation.closeHelpModmail: Like the Close button: the member is told by DM, the transcript goes to the transcript channel and the channel is deleted.
conversation.closeHelpTicket: Like the Close button: the ticket is closed (moved to the closed category if one is set), the member is DMed if that is on, and the transcript is filed.

confirm.title: Confirm close
confirm.effectModmail: The member is DMed that the conversation was closed, the transcript is filed and the channel is deleted.
confirm.effectTicket: The ticket is closed for the member (they can no longer write in it), the transcript is filed.
confirm.once: This confirmation works once and expires in 5 minutes.

route.gone: This conversation or ticket is not open any more (or never existed). It may have been closed in Discord.
route.goneNothingSent: This conversation or ticket is not open any more. Nothing was sent.
route.goneShort: This conversation or ticket is not open any more.
route.readError: The messages could not be loaded from Discord. Reload to try again.
route.tooLong: The reply is longer than {max} characters.
route.notePosted: Internal note posted in the channel (not sent to the member).
route.dmSent: Reply sent to the member by DM and copied to the channel.
route.dmFailed: The reply was posted in the channel, but the DM could not be delivered (they left the server or closed their DMs).
route.confirmExpired: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was closed; press Close again.
